score_only_effect.basis: The control applies no total-readiness threshold, so a 15-point readiness deficit changes no acceptance decision.

scoring_contract.feature_completeness_basis: stale factor -- half credit, not zero
scoring_contract.verification: 5/10 + 0/5 + 0/5 leaves 15 of 20 available points unearned, not 20. A 20-point loss would require feature_completeness to score zero, which the stale factor does not do.

veto_effect.basis: feature_completeness is classified DUPLICATE_DERIVED_GATE (class E) in V2_FEATURE_COMPLETENESS_DECOMPOSITION_V1 and is excluded from the atomic hard-block whitelist. Only a MODEL_REQUIRED_NO_VALID_FALLBACK or DECISION_REQUIRED component blocks, and no persisted evaluation carries one.

finding: MEASURED: the control contract contains no composite total-readiness threshold and no feature-completeness critical veto. feature_completeness is classified DUPLICATE_DERIVED_GATE and never hard-blocks; the readiness score is recorded on every decision but gates nothing. 609 of 748 qualified evaluations carry readiness below 70, which is only possible if no 70 threshold is applied.
